system.description:
The power of necromancy is well known across the planes. In some strange worlds, understanding of this dangerous magic becomes so precise as to restore almost all that whas been lost to death into undeath. Hence come the Macabre. Born of deep magics and careful rites, these beings retain much of who they were in life when they return. Their minds, their memories, some measure of the soul.

But decay, an extant form of life itself, takes its toll on the body left behind and reclaimed. Harm is done and must be repaired. Soft tissues repaired, or outright replaced, to maintain integrity once the animating spirit is returned. In this way, and others, the macabre return from the grave changed… sometimes in small ways that are difficult to perceive if the work is done well by skilled hands. In other cases, however…well; they are called macabre for a reason.

The vast majority of macabre were human, or near human, in their earlier incarnation, and the attributes of the heritage reflect that face. While there’s certainly nothing stopping one from making an Elven Macabre, it is advised you use the A5e rules for a mixed heritage to better explore the concept.

Macabre Traits

The Macabre exhibit the following traits:

Type: Humanoid (Undead)

Age: Macabre are made from human dead and are frozen at their current apparent age, typically between 19 and 55. They do not age but slowly face decay, appearing ‘more dead’ as the decades roll along unless action is taken to reverse the effect.

Size: Medium. The macabre average 5’10ft in height but typically weigh around 100lbs, resulting in an ‘underfed’ appearance compared to other humans.

Speed: 30ft

Breath of Life: The duration a macabre can hold their breath is measured in hours rather than minutes. You can hold your breath for a number of hours equal to 1 plus your Constitution modifier, with a minimum of 30 minutes.

Keen Senses: Macabre thrive in darkness and gain Darkvision with a range of 30ft. You also gain proficiency in Perception.

Camouflage: Macabre skin bears mostly ashen tones, allowing them to blend into environments fairly easily. You gain proficiency in Stealth.

Grisly Consumption: Unlike most undead entities macabre still require food and drink. However, the quality required for function sets a much lower bar. Spoiled food still functions as supply for a macabre with no ill effects. 3 pounds of decaying matter, plant or animal, also functions as 1 supply. Finally, macabre are also immune to foodborne disease and ingested poisons.

Still as the Grave: Macabre have advantage on checks made to appear dead.

Macabre Gifts

While all the Macabre are taken from corpses, some of those bodies are augmented with magic or technology to make them useful for more specific roles in the macabre society.

Cerebral Expansion

While you were dead, your brain was altered in a rather dramatic fashion, resulting in higher cognitive abilities.

Fast Learner: Cut any training or retraining times, as well as resulting costs, to 1/5th.

Mental Focus: Choose three intelligence or wisdom based skills that you gain expertise in. You may retrain these three skills during a long rest. You do not need to be proficient to gain this expertise.

Cortextual Stress: You gain disadvantage when making saving throws against mental stress effects. However, you also ignore the penalties of the first level of Strife.

Ocular Enhancements

When you look into the mirror, it’s hard to recognize the person staring back. The eyes are different, somehow.

Darkvision: You gain Darkvision to a range of 120ft, and you gain expertise to Perception checks based on sight.

Farsight: You do not take disadvantage when making perception checks to see something within 3 miles, barring issues of sight-lines.

Contraction Delay: Your eyes adjust to light conditions slowly, and you gain disadvantage on saving throws against temporary blinding effects such as flashbangs. The maximum duration of such blinding effects, however, is reduced by a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier.

Rejuvenatory Capacity

Your body was dramatically altered while you were dead and restructured to be exceptionally good at recovery from harm.

Recuperative Enhancement: When you recover hit points by expending hit dice, you recover the maximum value. When healed by an external effect of psionics, magic, or technology, you add your constitution modifier to the amount healed.

Regeneration: Any lost limb or digit regrows within 1d6+1 days unless replaced with a cybernetic.

Overactive Immune System: While you are infected with a disease, you automatically expend one hit die each day to make a saving throw against the disease. On a failed saving throw, you may expend additional hit dice to make additional saving throws, but take damage equal to the value rolled on each additional die.

Macabre Paragon Gifts

At 10th level, you gain an additional benefit from your heritage taken from the list below.

Cerebrumite

You now gain proficiency in any skill you use your Mental Focus on but do not already have proficiency in. In addition, you may now change the skills you gain from this ability at the end of a short rest.

Nightwatcher

Your propensity for darkness allows you to blend into it. In shadows and darkness, you gain advantage to stealth checks, and once per long rest you may become invisible for up to 10 minutes, so long as you make no hostile actions and remain in darkness or shadows during the duration.

Necromite

When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you no longer become unconscious and can continue to move and act as normal, but you still must make death saving throws.
